subject: Anmeldung Sohn U10 — wichtig: Asthma

triage.summary: Father Dennis Rosar wants to sign up his son Tim (born 2016) for the U10 next season, informs the club that Tim has mild asthma with an emergency inhaler the coach must know about, and asks what membership costs.
triage.proposed_action: Register Tim for the U10 for next season; forward the asthma/emergency-inhaler notice to the coach (medical flag for human confirmation); reply with membership fee info. Routine fee question stays part of the signup, no hardship involved.

details.medical_notes: mild asthma, carries emergency inhaler/spray, can participate in everything, trainer must be informed
details.other_family_at_club: Cousine Mia spielt bereits im Verein

policy_reason: Policy escalation: 'signup' is normally auto, but flag 'medical' matches ask_if
